title: Custom Flaming Soccer Ball with Custom Name Comforter Set - A12
description:
Inspire the young soccer fan in your life with this vibrant Jeminise comforter set, designed to bring the excitement of the field right into their room. This custom bedding set, featuring a dynamic soccer theme, is perfect for those who dream of soccer stardom.

Key Features

  • Meaningful Gift: Ideal for young soccer enthusiasts, inspiring them to pursue their passion for the sport.
  • Custom Options: This comforter set offers customization with a name and number.
  • Available Sizes: Comes in US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), and US King (104" x 88").
  • Easy to Use Bedding: Designed with a hidden zipper and a smooth metal pull for effortless duvet insertion and removal.
  • Durable Manufacturing: Features environmental protection techniques for color retention and smooth, compact stitching for lasting enjoyment.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; air dry without heat for best results.
  • Included Components: This set includes a duvet cover and two pillow shams.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter Set
Material Polycotton
Fabric Type Polycotton
Selected Design Soccer
Included Components Duvet Cover, 2 Pillow Shams
Customization Text input (name & number)
Available Sizes US Twin (68" x 88"), US Full (78" x 88"), US Queen (88" x 88"), US King (104" x 88")
Selected Size Full
Pillowcase Length 20 inches
Pillowcase Width 20 inches
Thread Count 360
Care Instructions Machine Wash
Style Modern
